Hello, this issue looks like an ERROR REPORT, for something not correctly implemented in Chart.js. It would be very helpful if you could please create an example chart that would illustrate this missing feature using JSBIN and even attached a mockup here of what the result should look like.

To help, I have created a simple JSBIN which you could fork:
http://jsbin.com/yozobahucero/1/edit?html,js,output

Sorry that this response is templated as we are triaging many issues and ones with test cases will be seen first.

http://jsbin.com/yozobahucero/30/edit

issue.title: remove padding on canvas; update markup example in readme

repository.name: angular-chart.js
repository.description: Reactive, responsive, beautiful charts for AngularJS using Chart.js: http://jtblin.github.io/angular-chart.js

issue.body:
Putting padding on the `canvas` element creates distortion of the chart & text within it. Solution to this is to wrap `canvas` in a container `div` with no padding/margin.

See https://github.com/nnnick/Chart.js/issues/507 for issue in Chart.js repo.

issue.body:
Hello, I'm having some difficulty displaying a chart inside a Bootstrap panel. If I place a basic line chart alone it works fine: ``` javascript var lineChartData = { labels: ['', '', '', ''], datasets: [{ label: "Memory Usage", fillColor: "rgba(151,187,205,0.2)", strokeColor: "rgba(151,187,205,1)", pointColor: "rgba(220,220,220,1)", pointStrokeColor: "#fff", pointHighlightFill: "#fff", pointHighlightStroke: "rgba(220,220,220,1)", data: [13, 56, 45, 34] }, { label: "Base Usage", fillColor: "rgba(246,150,121,0.2)", strokeColor: "rgba(242,108,079,1)", pointColor: "rgba(151,187,205,1)", pointStrokeColor: "#fff", pointHighlightFill: "#fff", pointHighlightStroke: "rgba(151,187,205,1)", data: [15, 18, 35, 66] }] } //Get the context of the canvas element we want to select var ctx = $("#memoryTrendChart").get(0).getContext("2d"); // This will get the first returned node in the jQuery collection. var myNewChart = new Chart(ctx).Line(lineChartData, { animationSteps: 15, bezierCurve: false, pointDot: false, showScale: false, scaleShowLabels: false, showTooltips: false, tooltipTemplate: "<%if (label){%><%=label%> (<%}%><%= value %> MB)", responsive: true }); ``` However, placing it within a Bootstrap panel doesn't work as I would expect. The chart will not be displayed: ``` html

Memory Trend

``` Also, I noticed that it's very difficult to get the width/height right even when in "standalone" mode. Looks like with larger values it works fine, but with smaller ones it does not (i.e. `{width: 100, height: 50}`) The documentation implies that the dimensions should be placed in the tag, but I'm not having much luck with it. What am I missing? Thanks!

issue.title: Responsive does not work with element height/width changes, only window changes

repository.name: Chart.js
repository.description: Simple HTML5 Charts using the <canvas> tag

issue.body:
http://jsfiddle.net/fzfy4dc0/1/

The issue is shown when clicking on a "+" button.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/3037266/6014817/5fe60408-abd0-11e4-9fd0-d1141312f294.png)

The example contains a flex container with 3 boxes. The middle box contains the chart. The surrounding boxes can change their widths and heights by clicking on the plus and minus buttons. When, for instance, the first box expands then the chart box sizes properly (as can be seen by the border) but the canvas does not resize.

If we drag the window bigger and smaller the canvas resizes properly.
